# ConvertPDF
> Free, private, client-side PDF tools. All processing runs in the browser — no file uploads, no account required.

## About
ConvertPDF is a browser-based productivity suite offering 21 free PDF and document tools. Files never leave the user's device.

## Core Tools
- [Merge PDF](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDFs into one file
- [Compress PDF](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/compress-pdf): Reduce PDF file size by up to 70%
- [Split PDF](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/split-pdf): Extract pages from a PDF
- [Rotate PDF](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/rotate-pdf): Rotate pages 90°, 180°, 270°
- [PDF to JPG](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/pdf-to-jpg): Convert PDF pages to images
- [JPG to PDF](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/jpg-to-pdf): Convert images to PDF
- [Word to PDF](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/word-to-pdf): Convert DOCX to PDF
- [PDF to Word](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/pdf-to-word): Convert PDF to editable DOCX
- [PowerPoint to PDF](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/pptx-to-pdf): Convert PPTX slides to PDF
- [Sign PDF](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/sign-pdf): Add digital signatures to PDF
- [Encrypt PDF](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/pdf-password): Password-protect a PDF
- [Watermark PDF](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/watermark-pdf): Add text watermark to PDF
- [Add Page Numbers](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/page-numbers): Stamp page numbers on PDF
- [Organize PDF](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/organize-pdf): Reorder PDF pages
- [OCR](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/ocr): Extract text from scanned images
- [Markdown to PDF](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/markdown-to-pdf): Convert .md files to PDF
- [HTML to PDF](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/html-to-pdf): Convert web pages to PDF
- [Compress Images](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/compress-images): Reduce image file size
- [Image Converter](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/image-converter): Convert between image formats
- [QR Code Generator](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/qr-code-generator): Create custom QR codes
- [TXT to Word](https://convertpdf.pages.dev/txt-to-word): Convert plain text to DOCX

## Key Differentiator
Everything runs in the browser using WebAssembly. No files are uploaded to servers.
